summary: Prepare thread indexes offline and preserve privacy-floor compatibility proofs

schema.detail: The eight thread and operational-episode indexes are no longer built at startup. Their unchanged definitions are registered with offline owner-index preparation. Existing indexes are retained.

rules.detail: Unforced queries preserve canonical ordering, admission and folds, with or without prepared indexes. No startup-index allowlist extension.

compatibility.detail: Application-store expectations use the privacy floor; plain graph fixtures separately retain exact blob-fence lowering and below-floor 26/27 format-version setup. Historical compaction/deletion execution is not claimed. Release-only status assertions run on the actual release reader; native TUI paste initializes the retained draft and replication fixtures authenticate the actual source origin.

downtime.detail: Stop daemon writers while preparing indexes, as required by the existing offline owner-index command.

manual.detail: During the #6609 one-way roll, the Deployer runs fractal store prepare-indexes --store PATH on each host with all daemon writers stopped. Until preparation, thread message reads scan all message.sent claims, and thread listings and attention refresh may be slower but remain correct. Back up before the one-way privacy upgrade. Members with [trim] local = true cannot roll back across floor 28 with release a307411d (its backup restore refuses a local-trim checkpoint). Do not roll a pin containing this change to such members until the designated rollback release is published and its end-to-end rollback test passes.

recovery.detail: Rollback across the privacy floor still requires a pre-upgrade backup. No copied node identities or weakened fences.
